name: Lily Kingston
source:
Waitress. She's very clumsy and a bit dense, but works hard and means well. This combination of traits tends to endear her to others. Her top priority right now is fitting in at work.

[spoiler]Lily* is a default name for the players of "Ristorante Amore", an online dating sim game made by planet Erewhon's scientists.
